Privacy notice

We keep only what we need to teach you, in the EU. You can download it or delete it at any time.

What we keep

Your progress, your settings, and a random guest id or your email. We never ask for your name.

Your voice

Only if you turn on speaking feedback. Your recording is checked, then deleted, unless you choose to keep it.

To give you feedback, PuhuScribe records your voice only while the record button is on, for a few seconds per line.

The recording goes from this phone through PuhuScribe's server to Microsoft's speech service in the EU, in Italy. The service turns it into text, and PuhuScribe compares that text with the line.

Microsoft does not keep your recording, and PuhuScribe deletes it as soon as your feedback is ready.

PuhuScribe keeps the text the service heard and how close it was, to check that the feedback works. That text is deleted after 90 days.

Keep my recordings so I can hear my progress. We keep your first and latest try of each line for 90 days. You can delete them at any time.

You can change both choices at any time in Voice settings.

How long

While you use PuhuScribe. A guest account is deleted after 90 days without use, and an email account after 24 months.

Your rights

See, download or delete everything from Your account.

Who runs PuhuScribe

PuhuScribe is part of the product family of Exentrik, a product studio in Finland.
